integrity: The normalized Gaussian formula and asymptotic minimax theorem are established analytically; finite numerical checks are corroborative, not a proof. Historical priority comparisons distinguish the published threshold-ellipse rate from the sharp squared-gain multiplier and rigidity.
scientific_limitations: Fixed channel count and equal channel precision; common squeezing only; large-disk asymptotics and local fixed-offset perturbations, not finite-disk optimizer classification; no statement of global nonlinear phase retrieval; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp large-disk Gaussian ambiguity coverage with optimal squeezing and angular rigidity
